posts.text: A Morpho lending market on Base shows 1,070 positions borrowing USDC against cbXRP, Coinbase's XRP-backed token, with debt of about 59.2M USD against 119.9M cbXRP. A 10% fall in the collateral price would put 8.84M USD of debt within liquidation range, while a 5% drop would bring 462 positions holding 3.23M USD past the 62.5% loan-to-value threshold.
